title: Fundraising Managers
description: Plan, direct, or coordinate activities to solicit and maintain funds for special projects or nonprofit organizations.

tasks.text: Develop strategies to encourage new or increased contributions.
tasks.rationale: decision support — Strategy drafts aided; executives own market judgment
decision support — AI tracks and models budgets; human owns allocation decisions

tasks.text: Develop fundraising activity plans that maximize participation or contributions and minimize costs.
tasks.rationale: text generation — Business plans drafted; human owns assumptions and risk

tasks.text: Plan and direct special events for fundraising, such as silent auctions, dances, golf events, or walks.
tasks.rationale: decision support — Planning aided; on-site execution is human

dwas.name: Organize special events.
dwas.gwa_name: Coordinating the Work and Activities of Others

tasks.text: Establish goals for soliciting funds, develop policies for collection and safeguarding of contributions, and coordinate disbursement of funds.
tasks.rationale: text generation — Goals drafted; leadership accountability human

tasks.text: Establish and maintain effective working relationships with clients, government officials, and media representatives and use these relationships to develop new fundraising opportunities.
tasks.rationale: interpersonal — Interpersonal business relationships are inherently human

dwas.name: Establish interpersonal business relationships to facilitate work activities.

tasks.text: Compile or develop materials to submit to granting or other funding organizations.
tasks.rationale: text generation — Assemble proposal documents from provided content

tasks.text: Contact corporate representatives, government officials, or community leaders to increase awareness of organizational causes, activities, or needs.
tasks.rationale: interpersonal — Public communication needs accountability and audience trust

dwas.name: Inform the public about policies, services or procedures.
dwas.gwa_name: Interpreting the Meaning of Information for Others

tasks.text: Conduct research to identify the goals, net worth, charitable donation history, or other data related to potential donors, potential investors, or general donor markets.
tasks.rationale: data analysis — Examines records for anomalies; human validates findings

dwas.name: Examine financial records.
dwas.gwa_name: Evaluating Information to Determine Compliance with Standards

tasks.text: Write interesting and effective press releases, prepare information for media kits, and develop and maintain company internet or intranet Web pages.
tasks.rationale: interpersonal — Public presentation is live human performance

dwas.name: Present information to the public.
dwas.gwa_name: Communicating with People Outside the Organization

tasks.text: Formulate policies and procedures related to fundraising programs.
tasks.rationale: decision support — AI drafts strategies; human owns operational judgment

dwas.name: Develop operating strategies, plans, or procedures.

tasks.text: Assign, supervise, and review the activities of fundraising staff.
tasks.rationale: decision support — Performance review aided; accountability and context human

dwas.name: Evaluate employee performance.
dwas.gwa_name: Judging the Qualities of Objects, Services, or People

tasks.text: Evaluate advertising and promotion programs for compatibility with fundraising efforts.
tasks.rationale: data analysis — Program metrics analysis, human owns conclusions

dwas.name: Evaluate program effectiveness.
dwas.gwa_name: Judging the Qualities of Objects, Services, or People

tasks.text: Design and edit promotional publications, such as brochures.
tasks.rationale: text generation — Document editing largely automatable with human review

tasks.text: Direct activities of external agencies, establishments, or departments that develop and implement fundraising strategies and programs.
tasks.rationale: interpersonal — Directing sales and service is human leadership and persuasion

dwas.name: Direct sales, marketing, or customer service activities.

tasks.text: Produce films and other video products, regulate their distribution, and operate film library.
tasks.rationale: text generation — Archival schema drafted; curation judgment human

dwas.name: Operate still or video cameras or related equipment.

emerging_tasks.task: Manage stewardship activities to maintain connection with donors.
